first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A bald, powerfully built person in the left foreground, with their back to the camera; broad red markings run across their light-colored head and shoulders, and they wear brown leather protective gear.

entities.name: Person C
entities.identification: A short-haired person sitting astride the saddle on Animal A's back, wearing a light gray-blue top and dark pants.

entities.name: Animal A
entities.identification: A large gray-brown horned quadruped in the right midground, with golden armor plates covering its head and back and Person C riding on its back.

entities.name: Dark Red Tree Canopy
entities.identification: Clusters of dark red and pink leaves and dark branching limbs at the top and upper left of the image.

entities.name: Weapon A
entities.identification: The spear beside Person A on the image-right, angled toward the upper right, with a silver-gray pointed section visible and a long dark red cloth revealed later.

entities.name: Weapon B
entities.identification: The long-handled axe on the image-right side of Person A's back, with a broad silver-gray axe head and a long brown handle.

entities.name: Weapon C
entities.identification: The partially exposed bow behind Person A's head and shoulders, with alternating dark and light patterns on its upper section and a thin diagonal string.

entities.name: Stone-Framed Wooden-Stake Gate
entities.identification: A gate in the background composed of a dark green-gray rectangular stone frame and orange-brown vertical wooden stakes inside it; in this clip, it is occluded by Person A, with only the stone lintel, frame edges, and portions of the interior exposed.

entities.name: Gray Stone Wall
entities.identification: A gray to green-gray stone facade in the central to right background, with block-like structures and dark areas.

entities.name: Gnarled Vines on the Wall
entities.identification: Thick gray-brown roots, thin vines, and green clinging vegetation covering the background wall.

entities.name: Courtyard Stone-Paved Ground
entities.identification: Irregular blue-gray-green stone slabs, gravel, and a winding paved band of narrow reddish-brown strips in the lower half.

entities.name: Ground Moss
entities.identification: Green grass clumps, low moss-like ground cover, and a small number of broad leaves in the midground and between the stone slabs.

entities.name: Courtyard Fungal Clusters
entities.identification: Clusters of red-orange umbrella-shaped and funnel-shaped fungi on the ground, interspersed with smaller yellow-green caps.

entities.name: Boxes, Baskets, and Containers by the Wall
entities.identification: A group of objects at the base of the wall on the left, consisting of brown rectangular boxes and dark round-bellied containers.

entities.name: Weapon D
entities.identification: A long silver-gray curved blade slanting across Person A's back, with a dark brown wrapped grip at the upper end.

The large curved horns on its head extend outward with upturned tips; the golden face armor has ridges, the back armor consists of a continuous row of pointed plates, and it is fitted with saddle gear, golden curved ornaments at the side of the saddle, and dark straps along its flank. A dark curved strap runs beneath the muzzle, and the rear portion and tail are occluded by Person A.
